main.description: The HappyView facts about a software.release.project that make it a plugin. The record key is the project's name, and the record lives in the same repo as the project. The registry indexes a project's releases only while this record exists and is valid.

project.description: The software.release.project this describes: the one in the same repo, under the same record key.

publication.description: The site.standard.publication that holds the plugin's display name, description and icon, in the same repo under the same record key. Pinned by CID, so a change to the publication takes effect only when this record is updated to point at it.

pluginType.description: What the plugin is. Every release must be of this type.

security.description: Where to report a vulnerability. At least one is required, because a plugin runs inside an operator's HappyView.

contact.description: A security contact. It must carry a url, an email, or both.
